'''bbs.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. It served copies of the main site, including ''Star Wars CCG'' deck-design pages.<ref name="bbs">[http://bbs.decipher.com/ Welcome To Decipher!], Decipher (December 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19981205191912/http://bbs.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
